items.title: A ‘ballerina’ from Eurosiberia finds a new stage in India
items.summary: During winter, in India, Demoiselle Crane sightings largely happen in Gujarat and Rajasthan. On February 28, 2026, the first sighting of a Demoiselle Crane was reported from Chennai Metropolitan Area. The only other records of Demoiselle Crane sighting from Tamil Nadu comes from Vijayanarayanam Tank in Tirunelveli. Naman Bora and Amoggh Chatty found the vagrant bird feeding in the reeds at Nemmeli salt pans near Chennai; the former would return to the spot the next three days and find the bird tenaciously clinging to this feeding spot

items.title: Can we deny caste on campus?
items.summary: Caste discrimination in India’s higher education institutions is a pervasive, systemic issue. Experts say sensitising faculty and students along with providing remedial support for students from marginalised communities is essential to address this issue. They also called for conducting independent inquiry into deaths of SC/ST students in India’s premier institutions.

items.title: Accountability: Why school learning outcomes data must be made widely available
items.summary: Measuring learning tells us where children are falling behind. A wider disclosure can make this information visible to parents and communities, and sustained action across the education system can turn it into improvement.

items.title: ‘Children are not a pilot programme’: Lucy Calkins on use of AI in schools
